global_rules: PhD and employment are terminal Main Quest outcomes; portfolio projects are evidence suppliers, not competing applicants.
An unresolved project does not block routes that can be supported by other verified evidence.
Unknown applicant facts remain explicit gaps rather than guessed defaults.
Preparation authority does not authorize communication, account creation, upload, attestation, payment or final submission.
External execution remains disabled until a route-specific handoff is reviewed under the Gauntlet browser contract.
A census denominator is not an executable queue until every selected row is identity-complete and live-verified.
